_comment: Formation presets. Slots are filled by role first, then by any remaining defender. Positions are field coordinates (home plate at 0,10; second base at 0,-9).

formations.name: Balanced
formations.text: General coverage of every route. A safe default.

formations.name: Turtle
formations.text: Collapses around home plate and the corner bases where routes converge. Strong late defense, little early pressure.

formations.name: Wide
formations.text: Spreads out to start intercepting runners the moment they leave the gates.

formations.name: Aggressive
formations.text: Pushes the team forward to crush runners before they reach the infield. Leaves home exposed.
